303	        """Run the checkout's tests and return the exit code and the tail of the output: exit 0 is

305	        no network, so this reports on the checkout as it is on disk. At most 8 checks per run.
306	        """
307	        if len(self.checks) >= CHECK_CAP:
308	            return f"error: cap reached ({CHECK_CAP} checks); report now"
309	        if self.sandbox is None:
310	            return "error: no sandbox; check is not available in this run"

312	        t0 = time.time()
313	        try:
314	            code, output = self.sandbox.run(self.root, self.run_dir, n)
315	            seconds = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
316	            log = self.run_dir / f"check-{n}.log"
317	            log.write_text(output, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
318	        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
319	            return f"error: {e}"
320	        self.checks.append({"exit": code, "seconds": seconds})
321	        tail = "\n".join(output.splitlines()[-CHECK_TAIL_LINES:])
322	        if len(tail.encode()) > CHECK_TAIL_BYTES:  # the end of the output is the part that says why

338	        return f"factory-check:{h.hexdigest()[:12]}"
